_help: Which repos get a card is decided by 'mode'. pinned = the repos pinned on your GitHub profile (nothing appears until you pin it). include = exactly the repos named in 'include', in that order. recent = whatever you pushed last (old behaviour). 'count' applies to recent mode only. 'repos' holds optional per-repo overrides (title, tagline, stats, tags, visual ...).
